The '''Hidden Temple''' was an ancient outpost built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Arkinnea]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] around [[Middle era of the Old Republic|the middle of the Old Republic]]. Over [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of disuse, it fell into disrepair and was abandoned. After the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] began, the temple was reconstructed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] and a [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan|group of younglings]]. It was used for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] as a shelter for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who sought refuge during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and became a subject of rumors among the Jedi survivors scattered around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
Built on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Arkinnea]] around the [[Middle era of the Old Republic|middle of the Old Republic]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the temple later was abandoned by the Order and fell into disuse. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] later, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was dismantled and [[Declaration of a New Order|reformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], an act that also nearly destroyed the Jedi Order with the implementation of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] that followed, some [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] managed to escape the wrath of the Empire, among them being [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Zao]] and [[K'Kruhk]], a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Chase Piru]] and a [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan|group of younglings]].

When the Jedi's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] crashed on Arkinnea, they were quickly taken for part of the ever-expanding flood of war [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] and placed into camps along with thousands of other beings. While the camps were crowded and unhealthy, they seemed to be on the path to a better life, until the Jedi discovered that the [[Arkinnea Militia|local security forces]] didn't want refugees on their world. The world was also being watched by Imperials under the command of [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Teron]], doubling the danger for the Jedi. Soon, it was discovered that the militia, guided by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Relik (individual)|Relik]], were actually massacring the refugees by dumping them over a canyon where they would fall to their [[Death/Legends|deaths]].

When Relik and the others found out that the Jedi had discovered their secret, K'Kruhk distracted them while the rest of the Jedi tried to make their escape. Regardless, the others were hunted down by Relik's cohorts until they encountered a native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Yunu]]. The militia members then attacked both groups; Zao deflected their [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts with his [[lightstaff]] then [[Telekinesis/Legends|hefted]] a boulder into the air and held them at bay. Soon, they escaped the militia, while K'Kruhk encountered the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] Teron, who revealed that he didn't believe the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] lies about the Jedi. He told the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] that while he didn't make much in the way of salary, he would try to provide the Jedi with whatever they needed, and return each spring with supplies.

The Jedi, along with their new allies, the Yunu, rebuilt the temple and the surrounding structures, struggling through their first [[Winter/Legends|winter]] but thriving afterward. Though Zao disappeared while tracking a [[Sidirri|runaway]] from the group, over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] the [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] grew into strong padawans under K'Kruhk's tutelage and the Jedi managed to live safely for a long time, a rarity under the Galactic Empire. Over time, the temple became a subject of rumors among other Jedi survivors scattered around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Decades later, the temple was abandoned once more with the construction of the [[New Jedi Order]].

A second [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] was secretly constructed to be a refuge for the Jedi during and after the [[Sith–Imperial War]].
